name: PubMed and NCBI E-utilities
purpose: Find biomedical and public health literature and retrieve bibliographic records
account_or_key: No account for public search or basic API use; optional NCBI account/key for higher API allowance
license_or_terms: NCBI policies apply; abstracts and linked articles can retain publisher or author copyright
exchange_formats: XML;JSON for supported E-utilities;PubMed citation formats
notes: Use official E-utilities for automation and observe usage guidance. PubMed discovery is not a full-text reuse licence.

name: Europe PMC
purpose: Search life-science papers and preprints and obtain metadata and licensed full text
account_or_key: No account/key shown for public read requests in REST documentation
license_or_terms: Article-specific copyright and licences; automated full-text retrieval limited to permitted subsets and services
exchange_formats: XML;JSON;Dublin Core for search;JATS XML for eligible full text
notes: Use API or permitted bulk services rather than crawling article pages. Check each article's licence; free reading does not establish redistribution permission. Main-site docs fetch failed; official developer-hosted documentation was reviewed.

name: Crossref REST API
purpose: Resolve DOIs and retrieve publication metadata, references, funding, and correction links
account_or_key: No sign-up/key for public API; contact email recommended for polite use
license_or_terms: Most metadata reusable for any purpose; some abstracts retain copyright; linked content has separate rights
notes: Member-deposited metadata can be incomplete. Record query and retrieval date; do not treat a DOI record as full-text access or complete evidence of study status.

name: OpenAlex
purpose: Explore linked works, authors, institutions, sources, and topics for evidence mapping
account_or_key: No key for basic documented API use; free account/key increases allowance; heavier use may be paid
license_or_terms: OpenAlex dataset CC0; API access policies and linked full-text rights remain separate
notes: Current help permits anonymous basic use. Verify current allowance and endpoint costs before a large retrieval; no quota is assumed here. Coverage and author disambiguation need study-specific checks.

name: WHO Data
purpose: Find international population health and health-system indicators and metadata
account_or_key: Public browsing/downloads; current API authentication requirements not confirmed
license_or_terms: Default CC BY 4.0 with WHO additional conditions; third-party datasets may have separate terms
exchange_formats: Machine-readable indicator downloads;format depends on dataset
notes: WHO flags legacy GHO OData deprecation and a replacement interface; the migration page did not establish a usable current API endpoint. Confirm the chosen download/API and preserve indicator definitions and revisions.

name: CDC PLACES
purpose: Study modeled small-area health outcomes and risk factors for public health planning
account_or_key: No account for public downloads; optional portal account for saved views; API throttling/token rules require checking for a production client
license_or_terms: Public-domain designation on official release records; retain CDC source and release attribution
notes: Estimates are modeled rather than direct local survey measurements. Check geographic level, measure, confidence intervals, release methodology, and the selected release's metadata.

name: NHANES public-use data
purpose: Analyze U.S. population health, nutrition, risk factors, and related survey measures
account_or_key: No login for public-use files; restricted files require a separate application and may involve fees
license_or_terms: Federal public-use data generally public domain; identify third-party material and cite survey/source
exchange_formats: SAS transport XPT;documentation and codebooks;some older text formats
notes: Scope is existing public-use data only. Use cycle-specific weights, strata, clusters, and analytic guidance; sensitive or detailed geography files are outside this free public-use entry.

name: World Bank Indicators API
purpose: Compare development, economic, demographic, and health indicators across countries
account_or_key: No API key/authentication for Indicators API v2
license_or_terms: Default CC BY 4.0 with World Bank additional terms; indicator metadata may state exceptions
notes: Record indicator code, original provider, source database, country coverage, revisions, and query date. This entry covers the Indicators API rather than every World Bank microdata resource.

name: FRED and ALFRED
purpose: Find economic time series and historical vintages for reproducible economic analysis
account_or_key: No account for public browsing/downloads; free account and individual API key required for API requests
license_or_terms: Service and API terms restrict uses; series-specific third-party rights and permission requirements apply
notes: Free access is not an unrestricted open-data licence. Check each series copyright notice and current service/API terms before publication redistribution or use beyond personal research; prefer original agency sources where appropriate. ALFRED vintages help track revisions.

name: OECD Data Explorer
purpose: Compare economic, social, health, and governance statistics with structured metadata
account_or_key: No API key described for public SDMX API; registration for updates is voluntary
license_or_terms: OECD data terms permit reuse with attribution except dataset-specific or third-party restrictions
notes: Use the current Data Explorer SDMX service rather than assuming old OECD.Stat endpoints persist. Preserve dimensions, units, reference periods, original providers, and revisions; observe rate limiting.

name: General Social Survey
purpose: Study U.S. social attitudes, behaviors, and change using repeated surveys
account_or_key: Public whole-file download links; Data Explorer saved workspaces or subsets may require an account
license_or_terms: GSS access terms request citation and responsible use; site copyright is separate and no blanket open-data licence was established
notes: Public-use data only; sensitive files have a separate request process. Review release codebook, mode changes, weights, and errata; clarify redistribution rights before repackaging raw files.

name: American National Election Studies
purpose: Study political attitudes, participation, institutions, and voting behavior in U.S. surveys
account_or_key: Public study downloads; restricted variables require a separate application and controlled access
license_or_terms: Research/statistical use conditions; no respondent investigation; citation and confidentiality requirements
notes: Use public-use files and release-specific weights/codebooks. The catalog does not authorize restricted-use access or attempts to identify respondents; public access does not erase the study's conditions.

name: U.S. Census Data API
purpose: Retrieve population, housing, demographic, and economic statistics including ACS tables
account_or_key: Free API key required for data queries under 2026 guidance; metadata queries exempt; web downloads have separate routes
license_or_terms: Census API terms; government statistics generally public domain with source/product-specific notices
exchange_formats: JSON;tabular downloads through associated data products
notes: Current key rule differs from older tutorials. Official June 2026 update documents metadata exemption: https://content.govdelivery.com/accounts/USCENSUS/bulletins/41aaf23 . Record product/year, geography, variable definitions, and margins of error; this entry is not access to restricted Census microdata.

name: Eurostat
purpose: Compare European demographic, economic, social, and public-policy statistics
account_or_key: No account/key shown for public statistical API requests
license_or_terms: Statistical data reuse allowed with source acknowledgment; individual notices and third-party exceptions apply
notes: The API serves current data rather than archived past versions. Preserve permitted retrieved snapshots and metadata for reproducibility; check comparability breaks, units, and geographic changes.

name: USAspending
purpose: Analyze U.S. federal awards, recipients, agencies, budgets, and public resource allocation
account_or_key: Public API endpoints currently require no authorization
license_or_terms: Public access documented; a dataset-wide redistribution licence was not established in this review
notes: No applicable data-licence/terms URL established; verify reuse notices and upstream source conditions before redistribution. Review award/account definitions, reporting coverage, revisions, and data-quality explanations; public expenditure is not by itself a measure of program effectiveness.

name: NCBI Gene Expression Omnibus
purpose: Find public functional-genomics studies and data for computational biology and methods replication
account_or_key: No login for public GEO downloads; optional NCBI key for higher-rate E-utilities search
license_or_terms: NCBI places no distribution restrictions on molecular database data but submitter rights may exist; inspect records and linked resources
notes: Choose public accession-level data with suitable metadata. Linked controlled-access human data are outside this entry; assess consent/context, batch effects, preprocessing, and study design before reuse.

name: ChEMBL
purpose: Use curated compounds, targets, assays, and bioactivity data for computational chemical research
account_or_key: No key shown for public data web-service requests
license_or_terms: ChEMBL data CC BY-SA 3.0; include resource URL and release version in attribution
notes: Keep assay context, units, curation flags, and release version. Share-alike obligations matter when distributing adaptations; bioactivity records do not establish clinical efficacy or a validated prediction.

name: OpenML
purpose: Find reusable ML datasets, tasks, fixed splits, flows, and comparison results
account_or_key: Public reads/downloads need no account; account and API key required for uploads
license_or_terms: Dataset licences vary; OpenML terms and each uploader's granted licence govern reuse
notes: Check dataset version, licence, original provenance, target definition, split design, leakage, and suitability. A hosted result is a benchmark record rather than independent qualification of a method; no upload was performed.

name: BioModels
purpose: Locate published computational biology models for replication and model extensions
account_or_key: Public model access described in maintainer training; current service/account requirements unconfirmed
license_or_terms: Maintainer training states hosted models are available under CC0; verify selected current record and linked assets
exchange_formats: SBML;other model and archive formats vary by record
notes: EMBL-EBI training was reviewed; current biomodels.org pages could not be fetched. Confirm current hosting and API documentation before retrieval. A model record or reproduced plot does not establish applicability outside its stated system.

name: R
purpose: Perform statistical analysis, graphics, and reproducible scripted research
account_or_key: No account/key for local software
license_or_terms: Core R is GNU GPL; contributed packages and documentation can carry different licences
notes: Record R and package versions plus analysis code. Check licences and provenance of packages and bundled datasets separately; software availability does not validate an analysis plan.

name: SciPy
purpose: Use numerical optimization, integration, differential equations, linear algebra, and statistical algorithms
account_or_key: No account/key for local software
license_or_terms: BSD-3-Clause for SciPy; bundled components may have separate notices
exchange_formats: Python source;NumPy arrays;sparse matrices;scientific I/O formats via scipy.io
notes: Pin the release and numerical settings. Choose algorithms for problem assumptions and verify numerical behavior; a returned solution is not evidence of model validity.

name: OR-Tools
purpose: Solve routing, scheduling, allocation, flow, and constrained optimization problems
account_or_key: No account/key for local library; separate cloud services or external solvers can have different access terms
license_or_terms: Apache-2.0 for OR-Tools; external solvers and dependencies have their own licences
notes: This entry covers the open-source local library rather than a paid hosted API. Record solver version, feasibility/optimality status, tolerances, and time limits; do not equate a feasible solution with a proven optimum.

name: SimPy
purpose: Build discrete-event models of queues, services, processes, and constrained resources
account_or_key: No account/key for local software
license_or_terms: MIT
exchange_formats: Python source;simulation data through user-defined exports
notes: A starting point for service delivery and resource models. Define warm-up, run length, replications, input evidence, and uncertainty; SimPy does not provide dedicated continuous-simulation features.

name: Mesa
areas: Social and Behavioral Sciences;Economics;Public Policy;Simulation Lab
purpose: Build agent-based models of behavior, interaction, organizations, and policy scenarios
account_or_key: No account/key for local software
license_or_terms: Apache-2.0; inspect example-model and dependency notices separately
exchange_formats: Python source;tabular outputs via DataCollector and Python data tools
notes: Model agents represent defined behaviors rather than automatically learned evidence about people. Justify rules, parameters, and calibration targets; pin Mesa version because APIs change.

name: OpenModelica
purpose: Model and simulate equation-based dynamic systems and exchange simulation components
account_or_key: No account/key for local software
license_or_terms: GNU AGPL-3.0 option; OSMC-PL alternative conditions; third-party components and model libraries have separate licences
exchange_formats: Modelica source;FMI/FMUs;simulation result formats depend on settings
notes: Select a released version and matching documentation; latest documentation can describe development builds. Review distribution/service obligations and each model library licence; interoperability alone does not validate a coupled model.

name: COPASI
purpose: Simulate biochemical networks and study dynamics, parameter estimation, and sensitivity
account_or_key: No account/key for local software
license_or_terms: Artistic License 2.0; dependency and model/data licences remain separate
notes: Use for computational natural-science research within Informatics. Document model provenance, parameters, identifiability, numerical settings, and validation comparisons; do not infer biological truth from a successful run.

name: The Turing Way
purpose: Learn practical reproducibility, project design, communication, collaboration, and responsible research methods
account_or_key: No account/key to read
license_or_terms: Book documentation CC BY 4.0; repository software MIT; third-party notices may apply
notes: Use as a methods starting point and adapt to the study's discipline and evidence requirements. Cite reused material and retain the edition/commit or access date because the handbook evolves.

name: OSF Registries
purpose: Find public registered study plans and document a human-directed research plan using appropriate templates
account_or_key: Public records readable without login; account needed to create a registration; private access requires authorization
license_or_terms: Registration and file licences vary; no blanket licence for all public OSF content
exchange_formats: JSON API metadata;registration pages;attached file formats vary
notes: Scope is registries/public records. OSF is phasing out Projects while retaining Registries and Preprints: https://help.osf.io/article/759-details-of-osf-projects-transition . Check the dedicated registration workflow and API before adopting it; a registration does not establish study quality.
